title: Row, Row, Row Your Boat on the Sea with Lulu | Nursery Rhyme
description:
Sing along to Row, Row, Row Your Boat with Lulu the little duck and Puppy on the calm blue sea! A golden sparkle twinkles on the water on every "merrily", Puppy dreams of his red ball, a little sailboat sails by far away, and Crab waves hello from the sandy beach.
The words light up with the music, for children aged 2 to 6.
A classic nursery rhyme (traditional, 1852).
